craft_notes: Sthāyin: southern gestation roll. Rows: catalogue kept whole. Read aloud: descending scale.

lines: Five days a finger, day-night parted too;
in-drawn, the southward road — womb-hood, birth-ache,
birth-and-sixfold change, Ram onward in rank.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra pratyaṅgulaṃ pañca tithayaḥ tatrāpi dinarātrivibhāgaḥ evaṃ praveśe dakṣiṇāyanaṃ garbhatvam udbhavecchā udbubhūṣutā udbhaviṣyatvam udbhavārambhaḥ udbhavattā janmādivikāraṣaṭkaṃ ca iti kramāt makarādiṣu iti
